entries.27b26e2b0749e77b: Partner companies that operate MVNO businesses
entries.51b240354f3c43f8: In Japan, this business provides mobile solutions tailored to the requirements of corporate customers, or of partners such as MVNOs, financial institutions, payment agencies, system integrators and manufacturers. Services began in January 2016. Through collaboration with payment agencies, it also offers services supporting non-retention of credit card information, and provides SIMs for local 5G to companies, educational institutions and others.
entries.5c658d8932c90924: This business provides mobile communications services tailored to each partner's requirements to partners that operate MVNO businesses mainly for individual customers. As a partner platform, it supports partners' MVNO businesses by providing communications networks, communication devices, authentication systems, billing and invoicing systems, customer management systems and others, and also entrusts network management, call center, logistics and other operations. Services began in November 2014.
entries.78d99df89549bb75: Individual users (including inbound tourists and small and medium-sized corporations)
entries.9a11d1d7553031d6: Corporate customers such as U.S. financial institutions
entries.9f3e7d766483fe78: This business provides mobile solutions in Japan and the United States by using the mobile communications networks of mobile carriers and others. It offers secure networks using dedicated mobile lines, dual-network products with redundancy through multi-carrier connectivity, device monitoring services, SIMs for local 5G and others.
entries.b1d35ae70c03526d: Under the brands "Japan Communications SIM" and "bmobile", this business mainly offers SIM-based internet connection services combined with voice call services and other services to individual customers. Services for individual customers began in December 2001. As of the end of March 2026, the number of lines under contract for "Japan Communications SIM" was 947 thousand. H.I.S.Mobile Co., Ltd., an equity-method affiliate, also operates an MVNO business using mobile networks in Japan.
entries.b73f4f02b4bd376e: Partners such as MVNOs, financial institutions, payment agencies, system integrators and manufacturers
entries.c5cc9a3010cd7d09: A telecommunications company that provides SIM services for individuals as an MVNO using mobile carriers' networks, and also handles mobile solutions for businesses.
entries.fa8f51f96d9cb556: This business provides mobile communications services as an MVNO or MVNE by using the mobile communications networks of mobile carriers (NTT DOCOMO and SoftBank). It operates in Japan.
